name: Goliath
title: The Philistine Giant
summary: Goliath was a giant from Gath, about 2.9 meters tall, who served in the Philistine army. For forty days he taunted the Israelite army and challenged them to single combat. The young shepherd boy David defeated him with a sling and a stone, in one of the Bible's most famous battles.

keyEvents.title: The Challenge
keyEvents.description: Goliath taunted the Israelite army for forty days and demanded a man for single combat.

keyEvents.title: David Accepts the Challenge
keyEvents.description: The young David, who had come to bring food to his brothers, offered to fight.

keyEvents.title: David's Victory
keyEvents.description: David defeated Goliath with a sling and a stone, in the name of the Lord.
